note: Pauses cut into assets/vo.mp3 so each line has room to land. After word `after` (an index into vo-words.json), music-vo.py splits the audio at `cut` seconds, a silent or near-silent point between the two words, and inserts `add` seconds of silence; reel-vo.html shifts the word timings by the same amounts. The pause lengths put the audible start of every line on a beat of a 120 BPM grid anchored on "Meet Mo", with "Click the link below" on a bar line, so the optional music bed (MUSIC=1) lines up with the voice. `dur` is the length of the reel in seconds.
